findings.description: saved_selection checks the top-level inventory only when model is absent. With the expected model, agent reasoning fields and auth.adopt_external_logins=false present, extra top-level provider routing, fallback_model or delegation settings are ignored. GET projects the clean requested triple; PUT passes the same guard and merge_existing=True preserves those extra settings. This is a current foreign-config refusal defect, not a claim that inference occurred or that the UI falsely claims effective compatibility. The finite empty/exact-owned store policy is already enforced for the no-selection case but disappears after selection exists.

reproducer.setup: Use the exact expected native model/agent/auth mapping from config_operation and add, one at a time: fallback_model={provider:openrouter,model:synthetic-foreign}; providers={openai-codex:{base_url:https://synthetic.invalid}}; delegation={provider:openrouter,model:synthetic-foreign}. No URL is contacted. Inject this mapping through the native read double; use the exact pinned pure _merge_partial_save/_deep_merge source for the save double.
reproducer.observed: All three foreign variants: GET returned the expected selection; PUT returned {ok:true}; foreign fields remained unchanged. Empty Save->readback passed, a no-op save against empty storage was refused, and foreign auth without selection was refused on the same function boundary.
reproducer.exit_meaning: The reproducer asserted and confirmed the defect; not a product PASS.
reproducer.proof_boundary: SOURCE only. Exact candidate config_operation/saved_selection executed. Native module and disk IO replaced; only two pure native merge functions were AST-extracted and executed. No native imports, file persistence, network, DB or provider execution. Native save_config lines2445-2447 statically confirm use of these merge semantics.

findings.minimum_remedy: Validate the complete finite stored configuration policy before both projection and save. Reject unapproved routing/fallback/delegation and other unknown sections/fields rather than silently preserving them. Permit only the exact owned sparse shapes plus explicitly audited harmless native metadata/default fields needed at this pin; do not remove native persistence or claim model compatibility. Add the existing valid empty/saved controls and these foreign extras to the config-operation tests, require zero writer calls on refusal, then focused re-review. If broader preexisting configs are intentionally supported, define their explicit native semantics rather than adopting arbitrary keys.

Current bytes still require F01 correction and complementary safety review before admission to native QA. Parent adjudication remains necessary.
architecture_adjudication.actual_reuse: The adapter does not invoke stock config_env GET/PUT handlers. It creates a restricted FastAPI app under the early patched native serve entrypoint and calls the genuine hermes_cli.config require_readable_config_before_write/save_config functions. This is native persistence reuse, not stock management HTTP handler reuse. It must be described that way.
why_not_demand_stock_router: Pinned web_server._lifespan lines153-203 reconciles SessionDB, warms gateway and starts hosted rooms; lines233-261 start reaper/selftest/archive/local-runtime/free-tier bootstrap. Suppressing only one startup task would not make the ordinary server a config-only consumer.

Pinned config_env.get_config lines81-92 applies _normalize_config_for_web even with include_defaults=false; web_server_config lines518-530 flatten model dict to model.default and discard provider identity. Its response cannot alone attest the exact stored provider requested here.

Pinned update_config lines118-157 relies on profile scope and late-bound web-server state/lock. Reusing that handler while replacing its dependencies and GET semantics is not demonstrably smaller than the finite adapter over the shared native writer/strict reader.

Do not grow this into a general REST proxy, copied config engine, duplicated OAuth implementation, another supervisor or separate durable Settings store. Future OAuth/model/catalog operations must be assessed against their existing native implementations, not assumed approved by this config-only decision.
